_comment: Populate one of these per recurring character BEFORE story production, then insert into Supabase's characters table. Auto-created characters (scripts/produce.py get_or_create_character) are a fallback for one-off characters, not a substitute for deliberately designed recurring ones.
name: Example: Lakshmi Akka
appearance: Rounded face, warm brown eyes, greying hair in a low bun, medium build
clothing: Cotton saree, usually in earthy tones (mustard, maroon, olive), simple gold jewelry
personality: Warm but sharp-tongued, quick with a comeback, secretly soft-hearted
speech_style: Mixes Kannada with occasional English words when annoyed or excited, slightly raised pitch for comedic emphasis
prompt_template: Flat 2D illustrated style, warm color palette. Middle-aged Kannada woman, rounded face, warm brown eyes, greying hair in a low bun, medium build, wearing a mustard-toned cotton saree with simple gold jewelry, expressive face, consistent character design sheet.
